title: Gradient Accumulation and Micro-Batching knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Effective batch size” in this lesson?
options: This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.answer_key: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.explanation: Effective batch size: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Accumulating gradients over multiple batches”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
confirm model and input devices match, supported dtype/device combinations are used, and the measured result is numerically acceptable.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: confirm model and input devices match, supported dtype/device combinations are used, and the measured result is numerically acceptable.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: confirm model and input devices match, supported dtype/device combinations are used, and the measured result is numerically acceptable.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Correct loss scaling”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not treat a GPU availability check as proof that all model operators or precision modes are supported.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not treat a GPU availability check as proof that all model operators or precision modes are supported.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not treat a GPU availability check as proof that all model operators or precision modes are supported.
